title: Felt standard library: board traversal and game primitives
description: Implement all built-in functions from FELT.md spec. Zone access (zone, components, cells, cell_at, count). Component properties (type_of, owner, rank, suit, property, position). Grid ops (adjacent, diagonal, neighbors, in_bounds, dimensions). Graph ops (flood_fill, flood_groups, connected, border, border_owners, liberties). Collection ops (map, filter, fold, sort, group_by, combinations). Grouping (count_groups, has_group, group_value, all_same, consecutive). These compile to WASM helper functions included in every binary.
